issues.concern: The gloss implies 'football' refers to American, Australian, etc. football, but not soccer. This is misleading because in many English-speaking countries, 'football' primarily refers to soccer.
issues.suggestion: Change gloss to 'football (various codes, including American football, rugby, and soccer in some contexts)' or similar, to acknowledge the broader English usage.
